name: Kabuto
description: An old Japanese iron helmet: a ribbed bowl, a laced neck guard of flaring plates, gilt horns over the brow and a red half mask with a scowling face.
notes: Standing on its neck guard, front on +z, 356 mm across the turned-back wings and 368 mm to the horn tips: a black ribbed bowl with a gilt band, four black lames laced in crimson round the back and sides, gilt horns and a red half mask with a white moustache over a laced throat guard. Iron in `steel-parkerized`, lacquered plates in `leather-black`. It covers the eyes and mouth as well as the head, through the mask. The model is a hollow helmet round a head-sized space. The xl and xs sizes share the model. A `helmet` host: the front point is the brow above the face where goggles mount, the side points sit over the ears and the rear point at the back of the rim. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Wolf skull helmet
description: The top of a huge wolf's skull, strapped on with leather and carved all over with fine winding grooves.
notes: Lying on its teeth, front (the muzzle) on +z, 340 mm from the back of the braincase to the nose, 140 mm tall and 376 mm across with its straps laid out: a bone braincase with a ridge down the middle, cheekbones round dark eye sockets, a long muzzle with the nose opening and upper teeth and fangs, chestnut grooves carved over the bone, and a brown leather strap from each cheekbone to a brass buckle. It takes no `helmet` attach points: bone and straps give nothing to mount gear on. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
